title: Warm Crunchy Filipino Pork Lechon
description: A classic Filipino dish featuring a whole pork belly cooked to perfection in a mixture of spices and wrapped in ti leaves, resulting in a crunchy and umami flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the mixture powder, black pepper, and salt.
Rub the spice mixture all over the pork belly, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and sear the pork belly until browned on all sides.
Transfer the pork belly to a large piece of foil and wrap it tightly, then wrap it again in ti leaves.
Place the wrapped pork belly in a large roasting pan and roast in the preheated oven for 2 hours.
After 2 hours, remove the pork belly from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Unwrap the ti leaves and slice the pork belly into thick pieces.
Serve the pork belly hot, garnished with chopped onion and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Garnish with additional ti leaves, if desired.
